meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆分开发任务为多个独立小改动,自动验证后逐个合并上线。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把开发任务变成多个独立小改动,逐个通过验证并合入主分支。
copy.tagline_en: Turn one dev task into small verified changes that merge one by one.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn dev tasks into small changes requiring individual review and merge.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 接管完整的 PR 流程：把任务拆成多个可独立合并的小 PR，每个在单独工作目录里开发，先做带证据的人工验证再写英文 PR 说明，循环跑 CI 和 Cubic 检查直到通过，然后自动合并并清理工作目录。
howto.when: 当你说“create a PR”“implement and PR”等关键词，或要求把实现以 PR 形式落地（包括只说“implement X”但语境暗示要 PR）时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个任务拆成原子 PR，并行开发并逐个合并。
say.note: 会触发拆分、并行 worktree 和 PR 全流程。

say.text: 实现这个 issue，走完整 PR 流程，通过后合并到 dev。
对这个改动建一个 PR，跑完检查和审查后自动合并。
say.note: 会进入验证循环，通过后默认自动合并。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude handle the full PR lifecycle: split tasks into small atomic PRs, develop each in its own worktree, require evidence-bound manual QA before creating an English PR, run CI/Cubic checks, then auto-merge and clean up.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', or similar keywords, or when implementation work needs to land as a PR, including just saying 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

say_en.text: Break this task into atomic PRs, develop them in parallel, and merge each one.
say_en.note: Triggers splitting, parallel worktrees, and the full PR flow.

say_en.text: Implement this issue, run the full PR workflow, and merge to dev once it passes.
say_en.note: Implementation via ulw-loop, verification, then CI and Cubic.

say_en.text: Create a PR for this change, run checks and review, then auto-merge.
say_en.note: Enters the verification loop and auto-merges by default.
